method: The user manually assigns each made or missed field goal to one of eight named court zones; the diagram summarizes those categories rather than inferring coordinates. Two-point zones are restricted area, paint outside the restricted area and mid-range; the corner, wing and top zones are three-point attempts. Field-goal percentage is made field goals divided by all recorded field-goal attempts. Points are two per made two-pointer and three per made three-pointer. Effective field-goal percentage is (all made field goals + 0.5 × made three-pointers) / all field-goal attempts × 100. Free throws are excluded. Empty percentages are shown as unavailable rather than zero. Undo removes the latest event, clear empties the current in-memory chart, and a chart accepts at most 500 shots. No data is stored or transmitted.
